title: 第017章 正法镇尸邪法驱魂五鬼道终遇活阎王第018章 你的邪器也配与我的极品法剑硬碰
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
与此同时，
马家高墙外的后巷阴影中，苏辰刚刚站稳脚步。
远处的阴影中，便走来两人。
凭借着自己的夜视天赋，苏辰很清晰的看清了两人的打扮，正是张家两兄妹。
“苏兄——”
张星野轻轻招手，快步向这边走来。
一旁的张清辞紧随其后。
然而，刚靠近后巷，张清辞挺翘的鼻尖微微一动，闻到了空气中弥散的血腥味。
“好重的血腥味！”
张清辞绣眉微微皱起。
“血腥味？！”
听到自己妹妹的话，张星野脸色微微一变。
他妹妹丹道天赋很高，对于气味十分敏感，她这么说，必然是马家出了变故！
“糟了！！难不成那玄门叛徒要用血祭的方法来催生鬼胎？！”
张星野意识到了什么，一张脸变得铁青。
“快！我们进去看看！”张星野当即脚下一点，身形轻若飞燕，直接跃上墙头。
苏辰和张清辞对视一眼，紧随其后。
三人伏在屋檐阴影里，居高临下往院中看去。
只这一眼，张清辞的呼吸便猛地一滞。
偌大的马家天井里，横七竖八躺满尸体。

白灯笼灭了大半，唯独灵堂里几根惨绿色的蜡烛还在燃烧。
地上的青砖，被暗红血线交错覆盖。
那些血线顺着砖缝，爬向后院。
更让人发寒的是，那些尸体摆放得极其规整。
大门口。
水井边。
灵堂前。
抄手游廊下。
每一具尸体的位置，都踩在阵法节点上。
“这个畜生……”张清辞手指死死扣在瓦片上，指节发白，“竟然拿活人填阵！”
张星野盯着尸体眉心贴着的黄符，又看见七窍里钻进钻出的黑气，脸上布满寒霜，“正法镇尸，邪法驱魂！”
“以血祭之法催生鬼胎，此人该受那火烙之刑！”
此刻，张清辞的脸上同样是一片冰寒，“哥，咱们什么时候动手？！”
然而还没等张星野开口，院中天井中央的灰袍道人忽然抬头。
那双阴鸷的眼睛穿过夜色，死死锁定三人藏身的屋檐。
他嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
“既然来了。”
“还像缩头乌龟一样躲着做什么？”
张星野眼神一沉，长剑出鞘，“被发现了！”
灰袍道人站在阵眼中央，灰色道袍被地下涌出的阴风吹得猎猎作响。
content_en:
At the same time,
In the shadow of the back alley outside the high wall of Ma's house, Su Chen had just stood firm.
In the shadows in the distance, two people walked towards them.
Relying on his night vision talent, Su Chen could clearly see that the two of them were dressed as two brothers and sisters from the Zhang family.
"Brother Su——"
Zhang Xingye waved gently and walked quickly towards this side.
Zhang Qingci followed closely behind.
However, as soon as he approached the back alley, Zhang Qingci's straight nose moved slightly and he smelled the smell of blood in the air.
"What a strong smell of blood!"
Zhang Qingci frowned slightly.
"The smell of blood?!"
After hearing his sister's words, Zhang Xingye's expression changed slightly.
His sister is very talented in alchemy and is very sensitive to smells. If she said this, something must have happened to the Ma family!
"Oops!! Could it be that the Xuanmen traitor wants to use blood sacrifice to give birth to ghost fetuses?!"
Zhang Xingye realized something and his face turned livid.
"Quick! Let's go in and take a look!" Zhang Xingye immediately stepped forward and jumped onto the wall as light as a flying swallow.
Su Chen and Zhang Qingci looked at each other and followed closely behind.
The three of them crouched in the shadow of the eaves and looked down into the courtyard.
With just this glance, Zhang Qingci's breathing suddenly stagnated.
The huge courtyard of Ma's house was filled with corpses.
Most of the white lanterns were extinguished, but only a few pale green candles in the mourning hall were still burning.
The green bricks on the ground were crisscrossed with dark red blood lines.
Those blood lines crawled along the cracks of the bricks towards the backyard.
What's even more chilling is that the corpses are arranged extremely neatly.
Gate.
By the well.
In front of the mourning hall.
Under the verandah.
The position of each corpse is on the formation node.
"This beast..." Zhang Qingci clenched his fingers tightly on the tiles, his knuckles turned white, "He actually used living people to fill the formation!"
Zhang Xingye stared at the yellow talisman on the forehead of the corpse, and saw the black energy coming in and out of the seven orifices. His face was covered with frost, "The right method suppresses the corpse, and the evil method drives away the soul!"
"Using blood sacrifice to give birth to a ghost fetus, this person deserves to be burned with fire!"
At this moment, Zhang Qingci's face was also cold, "Brother, when are we going to do it?!"
However, before Zhang Xingye could speak, the gray-robed Taoist in the center of the courtyard suddenly raised his head.
Those sinister eyes penetrated the night and locked onto the eaves where the three of them were hiding.
A sneer curled up at the corner of his mouth.
"Now that we're here."
"Why are you still hiding like a turtle?"
Zhang Xingye's eyes darkened, and he unsheathed his sword, "We've been discovered!"
The gray-robed Taoist stood in the center of the formation, his gray robes rustling in the dark wind coming out of the ground.
